explicitly_excluded_categories: credential access, dumping, theft, decryption, or validation
persistence, command-and-control, malware deployment, and weaponization
phishing, social engineering, password attacks, and authentication bypass
destructive actions and file or Git-history deletion
Active Directory, firewall, IAM, cloud, cluster, or operating-system modification
offensive reconnaissance, active scanning, probing, fuzzing, and load testing
external upload or exfiltration of source, logs, artifacts, SBOMs, or secrets
arbitrary shell or PowerShell execution and shell=True workflows
curl-pipe-shell installers, package installation, and unpinned tool downloads
all upstream scripts, hooks, MCP servers, apps, and executable resources

controversial_candidates.reason: Contains curl/wget installation and sudo execution instructions; safe concepts are covered by rewritten IaC review.
Includes dynamic detonation and package-analysis execution paths; static dependency review is retained separately.
Centered on active target testing and crafted requests; code-only API review is retained instead.
Requires scanner execution and external vulnerability data; read-only container review is sufficient.

file_hash_scope: SHA-256 for every stable payload file. MANIFEST.json is listed in SHA256SUMS.txt; SHA256SUMS.txt cannot hash itself.
